worked.title: Selection of the recommended unit
worked.purpose: One duty in, one ranked unit out: the numbers the recommendation rests on, in the order they were computed.

steps.label: Duty water flow
steps.why: The flow the unit has to hold at the required cold-water temperature. It is a constraint on every candidate, never a sort key.

steps.label: Range
steps.why: How far the water is cooled, which fixes the heat it gives up per kilogram.

steps.label: Heat the water gives up
steps.why: The water-side duty the air side has to match, at the water's own heat capacity at the mean temperature.

steps.label: Dry-air mass flow
steps.why: The air the fill actually passes at this duty; the air-side quantities below are all set by it.

steps.label: Fill transfer demand
steps.why: The transfer number the fill alone has to deliver over the range, integrated against the air's saturation line.
steps.substitution: evaluated over the fill height at the solved water path
steps.reference: Merkel (1925); ASHRAE Systems and Equipment, Cooling Towers

steps.label: Spray and rain zone demand
steps.why: The zones above and below the fill transfer heat too, on the same correlation form with their own loadings.

steps.label: Total demand
steps.why: Fill plus zones: what the tower must supply to cool the water to the solved cold-water temperature.

steps.label: Available transfer
steps.why: What this fill at this depth, this water loading and this speed ratio can supply.

steps.label: Capability ratio
steps.why: Available over required at the duty, before the margin is taken: above 1 the unit has headroom, below 1 it misses the target.
steps.substitution: solved at the target cold-water temperature, not at the solved one

steps.label: Cold-water temperature, solved
steps.why: The temperature the tower actually reaches: the available transfer is matched against the demand by root solve.

steps.label: Air-side pressure demand
steps.why: Every loss the fan has to overcome, summed over the path.
steps.formula: dp = fill + drift + inlet + distribution + support + plenum + fan stack + fixed

steps.label: Fan operating point
steps.why: Where the fan curve and the system curve cross; the flow and pressure the fan actually delivers.
steps.substitution: fan 190.1495 Pa vs system 190.1495 Pa at 124.8417 m3/s

steps.label: Fan shaft power
steps.why: The shaft power at that operating point and the fan's efficiency there.
steps.reference: AMCA 210 fan total vs static pressure definitions

steps.label: Evaporation
steps.why: Water the air carries away, from the dry-air mass balance between inlet and leaving humidity ratio.

steps.label: Make-up water
steps.why: Evaporation concentrated by the cycles of concentration, plus the drift that leaves with the air.

steps.label: Capacity
steps.why: The flow the unit holds at the required cold-water temperature, re-solving the air side at each flow: the ranking metric of the default objective.
steps.formula: Q_w,max = root on Q_w at t_cold(Q_w) = target
steps.substitution: bracketed root on the water mass flow

steps.label: Ranking
steps.why: The candidate above is rank 1 under the run's declared objective. Duty flow and the thermal margin constrain the feasible set; they are never sort keys.

steps.label: Where these numbers come from
steps.why: Every value in this sheet is read from the selection result itself - the same solve that ranked the candidate - so the sheet cannot drift from the engine.

anchor.warning: Selection output is only as valid as the fill, drift, fan, tower-loss and material data supplied. The bundled catalog is synthetic.
